offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures recreational powerboats, including sterndrive, inboard and outboard models, sold to individual boat buyers through independent dealers and built in company plants.

primary_products.value: sterndrive and inboard runabouts; outboard sport fishing boats; cruisers

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual buyers of recreational powerboats for leisure and fishing

revenue_model.value: product sales: new boats sold to dealers and sold on to consumers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds boats from purchased engines, components and materials, sold to independent dealers; brand owner: designs and markets its boat brands, sold through dealer network to boat buyers

geography_served.value: US national: dealer network across the United States, with some dealers abroad

specialization.value: related lines: two powerboat lines sharing dealers, plants and customers: sterndrive/inboard cruisers and runabouts, and outboard sport fishing boats

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent boat dealers that sell and service its boats

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: federal boat safety and emissions standards for engines, plus Coast Guard and EPA rules
